es.title: Estaño
es.extract: El estaño es un elemento químico de símbolo Sn y número atómico 50. Está situado en el grupo 14 de la tabla periódica de los elementos. Se conocen 10 isótopos estables. Su principal mena es la casiterita.

en.title: Tin
en.extract: Tin is a chemical element; it has the symbol Sn and atomic number 50. A metallic-gray metal, tin is soft enough to be cut with little force, and a bar of tin can be bent by hand with little effort. When bent, a bar of tin makes a sound, the so-called "tin cry", as a result of twinning in tin crystals.
